scenes.script_line: Ever notice how the loudest critic in your life lives inside your own head?
scenes.footage_search: young adult sitting alone in apartment, thinking in mirror, moody lighting, self reflection

scenes.script_line: Self-doubt whispers: You’re not ready. You’re not good enough. What if you fail?
scenes.footage_search: stressed woman of color at laptop, deleting email, anxious at desk, home office

scenes.script_line: Instead of asking, Am I good enough? try What can I learn from doing this anyway?
scenes.footage_search: freelancer smiling at desk with sunlight, writing in notebook, positive mindset shift

scenes.script_line: Maya almost didn’t apply for a promotion. She thought she’d fail. But when she reframed it as a chance to grow, she applied—and got it.
scenes.footage_search: businesswoman typing application on laptop, pressing submit button, celebrating promotion with colleagues in office

scenes.script_line: Take one step today—send the email, share the idea, make the call. Let progress, not perfection, be your proof.
scenes.footage_search: confident young professional sending email on laptop, making phone call, walking with purpose in office hallway
